name: kinetis/database-bridge
description: Kinetis wiring for kinetis/persistence: DB_* connection configuration and the default link binding, SQL spans through Kinetis telemetry, and a lazy request-scoped TransactionGuard whose cleanup is registered once a scope resolves it.

suggest.kinetis/migrations: Migration runner and migrate commands, connecting through this package's connection policy.
suggest.kinetis/query-builder: Parameterized queries and row-to-DTO mapping over the MysqlLink/PostgresLink this package binds.
